entries.title: A task split into parts shows how the parts connect
entries.body: When a task is split into parts, the center of the screen now draws it as a small constellation. A ring marks the task, and a line joins each part to the parts it builds on. Each working crewmate sits at its own point on it. A finished part's result travels along its lines back to the ring, and when the whole task is done the constellation folds into the ring, which falls home to Firstmate.

picture.alt: Firstmate with a constellation below it: a ring, two finished parts as small dots, two idle crewmates on lines from them, and an unstarted part joined to both
